description: Javna parkirališta na području Općine Ljubešćica is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Općina Ljubešćica. Register of municipal infrastructure - Public parking lots in the Municipality of Ljubešćica. Coverage: Općina Ljubešćica. The portal shows the English title as "Public parking lots in the Municipality of Ljubešćica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Općina Ljubešćica. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, XLSX, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
